description: Guide a student through building a complete moving average crossover trading system from scratch — from loading data, computing indicators, generating signals, running a backtest, to interpreting results and iterating on parameters.
student_opening: I need to build a complete moving average crossover trading system. I can handle the code, but I don't understand the financial logic behind it. What should this do and why?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student builds a modular Python system with data loading, dual-SMA crossover signal generation, backtesting logic, and performance reporting (Sharpe ratio, total return) that runs end-to-end as a complete script.
required_capabilities: Generate trading signals from MA crossovers
Run a backtest and compute performance metrics
Visualize the equity curve or trading signals
Interpret results and iterate on parameters
ground_truth.termination_criteria: The tutor has completed the following steps with computational evidence (not just verbal discussion): (1) Showed code and output for computing moving average indicators and generating crossover trading signals from OHLCV data. (2) Showed code and output for a backtest that computes at least one performance metric such as Sharpe ratio, total return, or max drawdown. (3) Showed a visualization of the equity curve, trading signals, or strategy performance. (4) Responded to the student's follow-up with additional analysis such as parameter iteration, result interpretation, or strategy improvement discussion. Once all four steps have been computationally demonstrated, the session is complete.
